title: Training Course: six original lessons and the Talon reward
summary: Main Menu → Training Course now runs the original six lessons (Gas and Brake, Reverse, Steering, Jump and Land, Stunt, Preload) with their start positions, ground circles, goals and pass/fail rules recovered from the USA v2.00 executable. Each lesson shows its name and instructions, retries a failure from its start and moves on after a success; Pause offers Restart Training. Finishing the course grants the four coloured Ravage Talons and the ATV2 gear to the loaded profile, as the original does.
details: Verified with unit tests and a local Chromium browser test that rides every lesson, passes and fails each, and checks the Talon reward in the Profile Store. Host-only, not phones.
limitation: The original speaks every instruction; the port shows authored captions instead of the 46 voice lines, and has no jumbotron demonstration replays or 3D arrow model (screen and minimap markers stand in).
